meta.title: Learn Claude Code
meta.description: Build a nano Claude Code-like agent from 0 to 1, one mechanism at a time

home.hero_subtitle: Empirical researchers without a CS background can read this and understand how Claude Code actually works. Every example is anchored to one completed empirical project — Patient Capital → Corporate ESG Performance — and each mechanism maps to a concrete node in that project.
home.hero_audience: Built for empirical-research grad students and early-career scholars, no CS background required
home.scenarios_desc: Each mechanism is described in plain language first — what it does, how its internal state changes. Then anchored with a concrete node from the Patient Capital → ESG project (8 PC measures in parallel, the do0–do10 task graph, overnight robustness auto-claim, and more).
home.scenarios_anchor_label: Where you encounter it in the empirical project
home.core_pattern_desc: Every Claude Code behavior sits on this loop: send conversation to model → model decides whether to call a tool → tool runs, result returns → model decides whether to continue. Every mechanism is an addition on top of this loop.
home.learning_path: If you want to read the Python
home.learning_path_desc: Each mechanism has a 30-800 line minimal Python re-implementation. Read the mechanism explanation first, then come back to the Python if you want to see how it works underneath. Python is optional — skipping it doesn't affect your understanding.
home.layers_desc: Tools, planning, memory, concurrency, collaboration — these five compose into everything Claude Code does in your empirical project.
home.message_flow: What conversation history looks like while it runs
home.message_flow_desc: Each loop iteration appends one entry to the conversation history. This is what's actually happening when Claude Code walks you through an empirical project.
home.case_body: Every mechanism demo in this guide is a concrete node from this real empirical project. The full pipeline runs do0_setup → do10_robust (11 Stata scripts): phase 1 produces main_panel.dta and 5 baseline tables; phase 2 closes IV/PSM, mechanism, heterogeneity, and the robustness matrix. Each animation you see maps to a specific step on that pipeline.
case_pillars: A2 framework · stable equity + relationship debt
IV1 industry mean · IV2 top-10 holders · IV3 PC lag

layers.title: Architectural Layers
layers.subtitle: Five orthogonal concerns that compose into a complete agent
layers.tools: What the agent CAN do. The foundation: tools give the model capabilities to interact with the world.
layers.planning: How work is organized. From simple todo lists to dependency-aware task boards shared across agents.
layers.memory: Keeping context within limits. Compression strategies that let agents work infinitely without losing coherence.
layers.concurrency: Non-blocking execution. Background threads and notification buses for parallel work.
layers.collaboration: Multi-agent coordination. Teams, messaging, and autonomous teammates that think for themselves.
